### [`distance_bands`](../../../../src/ai/ai_tables.asm#L51) `$C9B2-$C9D9`

*data*

<a id="ai_joystick_rows"></a>
### [`ai_joystick_rows`](../../../../src/ai/ai_tables.asm#L125) `$CB38-$CBE7`

*data*

AI joystick rows, 8 bytes each (22 rows). $870c reads row n at $cb38+8n. Each byte is a joystick value: bits 0-3 up, down, left, right, bit 4 fire.
